# Implementation Plan: codex-rs feature pruning for sub-45m cold build
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold"} -->


*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-01 (UTC) for task `codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold`. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold/plan.md`.*

## Overview

F-7 from the 2026-06-01 jobs-sweep benchmark established that the cold-cache build floor on this Windows dev box is ~50:12 (jobs=8 winner), and **adding more concurrency cannot break through to the AC-5 ≤45m target** — 4×→12× concurrency only shaved 7% (56:26 → 49:22) and ran into a critical-path tail dominated by `codex-tui` + `codex-app-server` + `codex-core` LTO link. The only remaining lever is **reducing TOTAL compile work**: prune cargo features that pull heavy deps the 4 produced bins don't actually need at runtime.

This plan does three things:
1. Adds a **dual feature-pruning mechanism**: wrapper-level `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` selection in `scripts/measure-build.ps1` AND Cargo feature-forwarding / `default-features = false` dependency-edge edits so transitive defaults can actually be pruned.
2. Ships **two concrete prune levers** verified by source inspection: Lever A — drop the `gif` image decoder from `tui/` + `utils/image/`; Lever B — gate `cpal` voice/audio_device modules in `tui/` behind a new `voice` cargo feature, default-off in the measurement harness on Windows (where the realtime-webrtc consumer is `cfg(target_os = "macos")`-only, meaning voice capture is dead code on Windows shipping unconditionally today).
3. Runs an **investigate-and-likely-discard third lever** (Lever C, aws-lc-rs via `rcgen` workspace feature swap) to confirm whether cargo's feature unification through `rama-tls-rustls`-in-`network-proxy` makes the swap effectively a no-op.

The F-7 candidate list mentioned `lalrpop` — research confirmed `lalrpop` is **not present in this checkout** (no Cargo.toml deps, no build.rs imports), so that lever is dropped.

The implementation gates ship on (a) cold-cache A/B measurement per lever via `scripts/measure-build.ps1` showing measurable wall-time reduction, (b) `cargo check --workspace` green, (c) release build of all 4 bins (`codex`, `codex-core`, `codex-windows-sandbox-setup`, `codex-command-runner`) succeeds, (d) runtime smokes pass (`codex --version`, `codex login status` no-network probe, `/audit`, `/runtime-audit`).

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
- **4-bin discovery (was a known gap):** `codex-windows-sandbox-setup` and `codex-command-runner` both live in package `codex-windows-sandbox` at `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/windows-sandbox-rs/Cargo.toml:12-18`. The launcher `codex` bin lives in the overlay package `codex-copilot-launcher` (`codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot-launcher/`, workspace member at `Cargo.toml:116`). The codex-core bin lives in `cli/` (package `codex-cli`, bin renamed via SANDBOX PATCH at `cli/Cargo.toml:8-14`). The publish workflow `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml:109-130` confirms all 4 are built together in release.
- **Feature-key facts:**
  - `image` workspace dep at `Cargo.toml:314` is already `default-features = false`. Per-consumer opt-ins: `tui/Cargo.toml:76` enables `["jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp"]`; `core/Cargo.toml:87` enables `["jpeg", "png", "webp"]` (no gif); `utils/image/Cargo.toml:12`+`:20` enables `["jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp"]` (duplicate dep line — likely target-block split; impl must view file).
  - `cpal = "0.15"` at `tui/Cargo.toml:129` under `[target.'cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))'.dependencies]` is unconditionally pulled in on Windows/macOS. `tui/src/voice.rs` + `tui/src/audio_device.rs` are gated by `cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))` (`tui/src/lib.rs:92-96` and `:199-205`), NOT by a cargo feature. The realtime-webrtc consumer at `realtime-webrtc/Cargo.toml:17` has `libwebrtc` as `cfg(target_os = "macos")` only — so on Windows the cpal capture path is dead code that ships unconditionally.
  - `lalrpop` is **not present** in this codex-rs workspace. Zero `Cargo.toml` deps; zero `build.rs` imports. F-7 candidate is invalid for this codebase.
  - `aws-lc-rs` flag appears once: workspace `Cargo.toml:352-355` selects `rcgen = { ..., features = ["aws_lc_rs", "pem"] }`. `rcgen` workspace dep is consumed by `codex-client/Cargo.toml:35` (TEST-ONLY: `codex-client/tests/ca_env.rs`) AND TRANSITIVELY by `network-proxy/src/certs.rs` via `rama_tls_rustls::dep::rcgen`. `network-proxy` is in the release dep graph (`core/Cargo.toml:51`). **Cargo feature unification** means swapping the workspace `rcgen.features` to `["ring", "pem"]` will not disable aws-lc-rs if `rama-tls-rustls` also lists it — investigation required before any edit.
  - `v8` workspace dep is consumed only by `v8-poc` workspace member, which is in `[workspace.metadata.cargo-shear].ignored`. NOT in the 4-bin build graph. No action needed.

### Technical Constraints
- **Minimize-conflict-surface mandate** (codex/CLAUDE.md Core engineering tenants §1): every edit inside `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/` raises rebase friction. Preferred order: (1) overlay crate, (2) seam-call from a 1-3 line upstream edit, (3) inline upstream edit. For feature-gating, the only feasible seam IS inline (`tui/Cargo.toml` + `tui/src/lib.rs` `#[cfg]` gates) — that's what the SANDBOX PATCH markers + §14 invariant + §15 replant recipe protect. Wrapper-level changes (`codex/scripts/measure-build.ps1`) carry **zero** upstream conflict surface.
- **Frozen iteration profile** (codex/CLAUDE.md Core tenant §4): do NOT change `CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO`, `CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS`, `RUSTFLAGS` between A/B runs — those are part of the sccache cache key. Feature changes are FINE (cargo's per-crate fingerprint factors features in; sccache derives its key from the rustc command line which includes `--cfg feature="..."`). The first build after a feature flip runs cold for affected crates; subsequent builds with identical features hit cache.
- **cargo build invocation gotcha** (codex/CLAUDE.md confusion-points): `cargo build -p codex-core` builds the `core/` lib NOT the bin. The bin invocation is `cargo build --release -p codex-cli --bin codex-core -p codex-copilot-launcher --bin codex`. The full 4-bin release build adds `-p codex-windows-sandbox --bin codex-windows-sandbox-setup -p codex-windows-sandbox --bin codex-command-runner`.
- **Wrapper env var is NOT a sufficient pruning mechanism by itself.** Cargo's `--no-default-features` ONLY affects packages named in `-p`, NOT their transitive deps. Cargo's `--features <list>` can only ENABLE features that the named package's `[features]` block defines. The codex-cli package has NO `[features]` block today, and verified release-graph edges currently activate defaults implicitly: `cli/Cargo.toml:63` (`codex-tui = { workspace = true }`), `cloud-tasks/Cargo.toml:27` (`codex-tui = { workspace = true }`, reachable from `cli/Cargo.toml:35`), `core/Cargo.toml:68` (`codex-utils-image = { workspace = true }`), and `protocol/Cargo.toml:22` (`codex-utils-image = { workspace = true }`). Therefore pruning requires per-package `[features]` definitions, `default-features = false` on every release-graph dependency edge that can reactivate `codex-tui` / `codex-utils-image` defaults, explicit feature forwarding from `codex-cli` down through `codex-core`, `codex-protocol`, `codex-cloud-tasks`, `codex-tui`, and `codex-utils-image`, `#[cfg(feature = "...")]` source gates where needed, and wrapper env-var translation to select the top-level `codex-cli` features. All pieces are required; the wrapper env var alone does nothing.
- **No public Codex/Copilot research streams completed for this plan** — both async-exec wrappers lost stdio on shell teardown. The plan was drafted from researcher + architect Explore agent output plus direct source inspection by the planner. Phase 4 review will retry both reviewers synchronously.

## Approach

### Architecture

Three orthogonal levers, each opt-in via a cargo feature defined in the relevant package's `[features]` block. The measurement harness (`scripts/measure-build.ps1`) reads `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` (CSV of known top-level `codex-cli` feature names, e.g. `voice,image-gif`) and translates it into `--no-default-features --features ...` for the top-level package being measured. The harness rejects feature names outside its fixed allowlist before invoking cargo. The Cargo manifests then do the real pruning: dependency edges from `codex-cli` / reachable release-graph packages to `codex-tui`, `codex-core`, `codex-protocol`, and `codex-utils-image` must use `default-features = false`, and each parent package must re-export the prune points in its own `[features]` block. Default builds (no env var set) compile every feature on through those `[features] default = [...]` entries, so distribution builds and developers not on the measurement path see zero behavior change.

```
                          ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                          │ CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE env var │
                          │  (CSV: "voice,image-gif")      │
                          └──────────────┬─────────────────┘
                                         │
                                         ▼
                ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
                │ scripts/measure-build.ps1                      │
                │   parses CSV → top-level --no-default-features │
                │   + --features image-gif,voice                 │
                └──────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
   cargo build --release  (4 bins; top-level feature selection)
                               │
                               ▼
       Cargo feature forwarding honors the selected features:
        - voice → codex-cli/voice → codex-tui/voice through dep edges
        - image-gif → codex-cli/image-gif → codex-tui + codex-utils-image image-gif
        - omitted features stay pruned because dep edges set default-features=false
        - default (no override) → today's behavior, all features on
```

Before relying on any pruned build, run `rg -n "codex-tui|codex-utils-image|codex-core|codex-protocol" external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs -g Cargo.toml` and update every release-graph dependency edge that can reactivate the target package's defaults. Lever's BEFORE/AFTER measurement uses this exact invocation pattern.

   - `pwsh codex/scripts/runtime_audit.ps1` (no allowlist breaches).

**Lever A — Image-gif prune (US-002):**
- `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml` — add `[features]` block:
  ```toml
  [features]
  default = ["image-gif"]
  image-gif = []  # opt-in for the gif decoder; off in measurement harness via CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE
  ```
  Change line 76 from:
  ```toml
  image = { workspace = true, features = ["jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp"] }
  ```
  to two-line conditional:
  ```toml
  # SANDBOX PATCH: gif decoder behind opt-in feature (default-on); see patch-surface.md §14 inv-N + §15 replant.
  image = { workspace = true, features = ["jpeg", "png", "webp"] }
  ```
  ...and add a conditional re-opt-in:
  ```toml
  [target.'cfg(any())'.dependencies]  # placeholder for the feature-gated decoder
  ```
  Actually — cargo doesn't allow conditional `features = [...]` on the same dep line. The real edit: keep `image = { workspace = true, features = ["jpeg", "png", "webp"] }` as the base, then re-enable `gif` from the source side if the feature is on (via `image::ImageFormat::Gif` calls becoming `#[cfg(feature = "image-gif")]`). **OR** declare a separate feature-gated `image` dep with `features = ["gif"]` under `[target.'cfg(feature = "image-gif")'.dependencies]`. The impl spike must confirm which pattern cargo accepts; the simpler pattern is: keep the always-on dep with the minimal feature set, and ADD a conditional dep via cargo's `optional = true` pattern in `[features]`:
  ```toml
  [features]
  default = ["image-gif"]
  image-gif = []
  ```
  ...and the cargo `image` crate's features are NOT package-dep features that cargo can conditionally enable post-hoc — cargo activates dependency-features at resolution time. The cleanest cargo-native pattern is `[features] image-gif = ["image/gif"]` which ADDS the gif decoder when the feature is enabled. So:
  ```toml
  image = { workspace = true, features = ["jpeg", "png", "webp"] }
  [features]
  default = ["image-gif"]
  image-gif = ["image/gif"]
  ```
  **This is the canonical cargo idiom.** Same shape applied to `utils/image/Cargo.toml`.

- `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/utils/image/Cargo.toml` — same shape, both `image = ...` lines (`:12` and `:20`).
- `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/Cargo.toml` (workspace) — DO NOT modify. The workspace `image = { default-features = false }` is already correct.

- `codex/scripts/measure-build.ps1` — add a parameter / env-var read block before the cargo invocation:
  ```pwsh
  # CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE: CSV of known codex-cli feature names, e.g. "voice,image-gif".
  # When set, the measurement harness invokes cargo for codex-cli with
  # --no-default-features --features <list>.
  # Note: this ENABLES the listed top-level features; pruning works only because Cargo.toml
  # dep edges set default-features=false and re-export downstream features. See
  # patch-surface.md §14 inv-N for the per-package feature definitions this harness depends on.
  $featureOverride = $env:CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE

      # Accept only the known feature names that codex-cli re-exports; reject
      # package-style or directory-style strings such as tui/voice before cargo runs.
      $allowedFeatures = @('voice', 'image-gif')
      $features = @()
      foreach ($feature in $featureOverride.Split(',')) {
          $name = $feature.Trim()
          if ($allowedFeatures -notcontains $name) { Write-PreflightError "Unknown CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE feature: $name" }
          $features += $name
      }
      # Translate the allowlisted list into --no-default-features --features <list>
      # on the codex-cli cargo invocation. Verify the final arg order with -ParseOnly.
  }
  ```

- `codex/docs/implementation/build-perf.md` — add 3 rows to the results table (one per lever attempted): `feature-prune-image-gif`, `feature-prune-voice`, `feature-prune-aws-lc-rs` with wall-time, peak RSS, sccache delta, exit code. Update the cold-cache target floor section per actual achieved time. Cross-link the `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` env-var documentation.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Adding wrapper-level `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` env-var seam to `scripts/measure-build.ps1`.
- Adding Cargo feature-forwarding and `default-features = false` dependency-edge edits in the release graph so `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` can actually prune transitive defaults (`cli`, `cloud-tasks`, `core`, `protocol`, and any additional rg-discovered edge required by the final graph).
- Lever A: `image-gif` cargo feature in `tui/Cargo.toml` + `utils/image/Cargo.toml` (default-on for dist; default-off in measurement).
- Lever B: `voice` cargo feature in `tui/Cargo.toml` (default-on for dist; default-off in measurement). Generalized real-module/stub gates in `tui/src/lib.rs` so feature-off builds compile no-op `voice` / `audio_device` surfaces without pulling `cpal`; consumer paths verified against those stubs.
- Lever C: `aws-lc-rs` swap investigation via `cargo tree`; conditional Cargo.toml edit if unification doesn't block.
- Per-lever cold-cache A/B measurement using `scripts/measure-build.ps1` with frozen iteration profile after the harness is extended to build all 4 release bins.
- Updating `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` §14 + §15 for every SANDBOX PATCH landed.
- Updating `docs/implementation/build-perf.md` results table with measurements.

### Out of Scope
- `lalrpop` lever (not present in the codebase — F-7 mention was wrong).
- `syntect` / `two-face` removal (user-visible degradation of code-block highlighting). Filed as separate follow-up candidate.
- `sqlx` sqlite-bundled → sqlite-system swap (needs system sqlite installed on the dev box). Separate follow-up.
- `tonic` (otel/grpc) prune (otel may be runtime-configured; needs UX check). Separate follow-up.
- Concurrency tuning (settled at jobs=8 per the jobs-sweep ship).
- LTO profile changes (frozen iteration profile mandate — `LTO=off` for sccache-effective iteration; release uses `lto = "fat"`).
- Defender exclusion changes (separate followup `codex-rs-defender-exclusions-procmon-verify`).
- Any change to the released distribution behavior — all levers MUST leave defaults-on so `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml` builds the same set of decoders and modules as today.

## Risk Areas

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|----------|------------|
| Lever C (aws-lc-rs) compiles aws-lc-rs anyway via `rama-tls-rustls` unification | Medium (wasted impl work) | Pre-flight `cargo tree -e features -i aws-lc-rs` BEFORE any edit; investigate-and-skip if confirmed. |
| Feature-off voice stub surface misses a consumer method | Medium (compile failure) | Generalize the existing Linux stubs in `tui/src/lib.rs` to `#[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", not(feature = "voice")))]`, keep the no-op `audio_device` and `voice` APIs aligned with the real modules, and verify `cargo build -p codex-tui --no-default-features --features image-gif` plus the full pruned 4-bin build. |
| Image-gif source calls (`image::ImageFormat::Gif`) are not isolated to feature-gated paths | Low | Cargo's `image-gif = ["image/gif"]` feature-routing pattern lets the gif format simply not be registered when off — the `image::ImageFormat::Gif` variant remains a valid enum value but decoding attempts return an `UnsupportedFormat` error. No call-site changes needed. |
| Measurement noise masks a real per-lever saving | Medium | Run each A/B with full wipe (sccache cache + `target/release`) AND require BOTH measurements to be cold (don't compare a warm AFTER to a cold BEFORE). Capture peak RSS, sccache request count, exit code — divergent metrics indicate environmental confound. If a lever's measured delta is <30 sec, consider it noise-bound and document as "no measurable savings on this dev box" rather than shipping with a fake claim. |
| Workspace `Cargo.lock` drift from the per-package feature edits triggers Bazel `MODULE.bazel.lock` regeneration requirement | Low | Per codex/external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md: "If you change Rust dependencies (`Cargo.toml` or `Cargo.lock`), run `just bazel-lock-update` from the repo root to refresh `MODULE.bazel.lock`." Impl must run this and include the lockfile update in the same commit. Verify with `just bazel-lock-check`. |
| Cold-build A/B doesn't hit the aspirational AC-5 ≤45m target even with all 3 levers landed | High (plan fails to meet AC if no measurable reduction) | The plan's hard success gate is a measurable cold-cache reduction, not documentation alone. Ship only if the combined post-change cold-cache wall-time is at least 1 minute faster than the 50:12 jobs=8 pre-change baseline and no individual lever's post-change cold-cache wall-time exceeds that baseline; if the combined levers save <1 minute, do not merge and file `codex-rs-feature-pruning-residual-<bottleneck>` with cargo-bloat / cargo-timings evidence pointing at the next bottleneck (likely `codex-app-server` or `codex-tui` LTO link itself). |
| SANDBOX PATCH proliferation increases rebase friction | Medium | The plan adds several SANDBOX PATCH markers across feature definitions, forwarding dep edges, source gates, and optionally workspace/Cargo.toml. Each gets a §14 invariant + §15 replant recipe in the same commit. Replant recipes use the cargo-native `[features] x = ["dep/feature"]` idiom which upstream is unlikely to reorganize. |
| Wrapper env-var translation in measure-build.ps1 emits wrong cargo flags | Low | Add a `-ParseOnly` smoke test variant that prints the resolved cargo invocation without running it; impl agent verifies the resolved arg list before going live. |
| Missed release-graph dependency edge silently reactivates `codex-tui` or `codex-utils-image` defaults | High | Pre-flight `rg` all `Cargo.toml` edges to `codex-tui`, `codex-core`, `codex-protocol`, and `codex-utils-image`; edit every release-graph edge to `default-features = false` with explicit forwarding; verify with `cargo tree -e features` that pruned builds do not activate `cpal` or `image/gif`. |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Wrapper seam):** `scripts/measure-build.ps1 -ParseOnly` with `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` unset prints the default 4-bin cargo invocation: `-p codex-cli --bin codex-core -p codex-copilot-launcher --bin codex -p codex-windows-sandbox --bin codex-windows-sandbox-setup -p codex-windows-sandbox --bin codex-command-runner`. With `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE=voice,image-gif`, it prints the same 4-bin invocation plus the expected top-level `--no-default-features --features voice,image-gif` flags for `codex-cli`; with an unknown or package-style entry such as `tui/voice`, it fails before invoking cargo. **Verification:** parseOnly output captured to plan artifact; reviewer inspects.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Lever A landed):** `tui/Cargo.toml` and `utils/image/Cargo.toml` have a `[features]` block with `default = ["image-gif", ...]` and `image-gif = ["image/gif"]`; `cli`, `cloud-tasks`, `core`, `protocol`, and any additional rg-discovered release-graph edge forward `image-gif` with `default-features = false` on the relevant dependencies. Workspace `cargo check --workspace` passes. Release build of all 4 bins passes. `cargo build --release -p codex-tui --no-default-features --features ...` (omitting image-gif) succeeds and `cargo tree -e features` for the pruned 4-bin build shows `image/gif` is not activated. Cold-cache A/B measurement captured in `measurements/lever-a-*.csv` using the full 4-bin `measure-build.ps1` invocation.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Lever B landed):** `tui/Cargo.toml` has `cpal = { ..., optional = true }` and `[features] voice = ["dep:cpal"]`; `cli`, `cloud-tasks`, and any additional rg-discovered `codex-tui` release-graph edge forward `voice` with `default-features = false`. `tui/src/lib.rs` compiles the real `mod voice` + `mod audio_device` only under `#[cfg(all(not(target_os = "linux"), feature = "voice"))]` and compiles matching no-op stubs under `#[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", not(feature = "voice")))]`. Workspace `cargo check --workspace` passes. Release build of all 4 bins passes. `cargo build --release -p codex-tui --no-default-features --features image-gif` (no voice) succeeds and `cargo tree -e features` for the pruned 4-bin build shows `cpal` is not activated; runtime smoke `codex --version` returns expected version. Cold-cache A/B measurement captured in `measurements/lever-b-*.csv` using the full 4-bin `measure-build.ps1` invocation.
- [ ] **AC-4 (Lever C investigated):** `cargo-tree-aws-lc-rs-before.txt` captured. If the swap is applied, `cargo-tree-aws-lc-rs-after.txt` shows aws-lc-rs no longer in graph; if not applied (rama-tls-rustls unification confirmed), the investigation note in plan ship summary cites the rama-tls-rustls evidence.
- [ ] **AC-5 (Cold-cache wall-time):** **HARD pass condition:** the combined post-change cold-cache wall-time using the full 4-bin `measure-build.ps1` invocation is strictly less than the 50:12 jobs=8 pre-change baseline from 2026-06-01 by at least 1 minute, and no individual lever's post-change cold-cache wall-time exceeds that pre-change baseline. **Aspirational target:** ≤45m. If the achieved time is >45m but the hard pass condition is met, the plan ship summary explicitly states the achieved wall-time, the remaining gap, the next-bottleneck evidence (e.g., cargo-bloat and/or cargo-timings excerpt showing which crate took the longest single span), and files a follow-up task `codex-rs-feature-pruning-residual-<bottleneck>`. If the combined levers save <1 minute, do not merge; file the residual task with cargo-bloat / cargo-timings evidence instead. The ship requires a measurable reduction, not just captured A/B evidence.
- [ ] **AC-6 (No functional regression on default build):** With NO `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` env var set, `pwsh scripts/measure-build.ps1 -Scenario "regression-check"` produces the full 4-bin build and remains identical-in-functionality to pre-change main (same decoder set, same TUI voice path on Windows). Verified by:
  - Default-feature `cargo build --release` includes `cpal` and the gif decoder.
  - `codex --version` returns expected version string.
  - `codex login status` parses and initializes without launching an interactive auth flow; authenticated success or the expected `Not logged in` exit is acceptable, but unknown-option/parser failures are not.
  - `bash codex/scripts/audit_network_calls.sh` — no new endpoints / patch-marker drift.
  - `pwsh codex/scripts/runtime_audit.ps1` — no allowlist breaches.
- [ ] **AC-7 (Docs landed):** `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` §14 has 1-3 new invariant rows (per SANDBOX PATCHes actually landed) with enforcing test/guard reference. §15 has a Feature-prune replant recipe. `docs/implementation/build-perf.md` results table has rows for every lever measurement (before AND after for each).
- [ ] **AC-8 (Bazel lockfile):** `just bazel-lock-update` run after the per-package Cargo.toml edits land; resulting `MODULE.bazel.lock` update committed in the same commit. `just bazel-lock-check` passes (no further drift).
- [ ] **AC-9 (Phase 5a code review convergence):** at least one reviewer round (Claude required; Codex + Copilot if available) reaches `{code: 'clean'}`. Per the impl-with-ralph Phase 5a convention.
- [ ] **AC-10 (Phase 5b docs review convergence):** docs reviewer round reaches `{docs: 'clean'}`. Per Phase 5b convention.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

- **US-001** — Wrapper seam: extend `scripts/measure-build.ps1` to measure all 4 release bins, then add `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` env-var translation.
- **US-002** — Lever A: image-gif feature in `tui/Cargo.toml` + `utils/image/Cargo.toml` + release-graph feature-forwarding dep edges; A/B measurement.
- **US-003** — Lever B: voice feature in `tui/Cargo.toml` + release-graph feature-forwarding dep edges + generalized `tui/src/lib.rs` real-module/stub gates + consumer verification against the stubs; A/B measurement.
- **US-004** — Lever C: aws-lc-rs investigation via `cargo tree`; conditional SANDBOX PATCH; A/B measurement if applied.
- **US-005** — Docs: `patch-surface.md` §14 + §15, `build-perf.md` results-table fill, `iteration-env.sh` banner update.

## Suggested Decomposition

Cluster the preliminary stories for possible parallel execution. Three clusters in two phases:

### Cluster: `wrapper-seam`
- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[]; exclusive=[`codex/scripts/measure-build.ps1`, `codex/scripts/iteration-env.sh` banner-only]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Wrapper-only, no Cargo.toml touch, no source code touch. Zero overlap with other clusters. Runs first because Levers A/B/C measurement consumes this env-var.

### Cluster: `aws-lc-rs-investigation`
- Stories: US-004
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[]; exclusive=[`codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/Cargo.toml` (workspace dep change — ONLY if cargo tree gives the green light)]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Read-only investigation phase has zero edits; conditional impl edit touches workspace Cargo.toml which has no overlap with the other clusters' files. Can run fully in parallel with Cluster `wrapper-seam`.

### Cluster: `tui-feature-gates`
- Stories: US-002, US-003
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: `wrapper-seam`
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml`, `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml`, `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/cloud-tasks/Cargo.toml`]; exclusive per story=[US-002: `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/utils/image/Cargo.toml`, `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml`, `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/protocol/Cargo.toml`; US-003: `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/tui/src/lib.rs` + tui/src consumer files]; risk=medium
- `execution_mode` rationale: BOTH stories edit `tui/Cargo.toml` (`[features]` block) and top-level forwarding in `cli/Cargo.toml` / `cloud-tasks/Cargo.toml`. Cargo refuses overlapping `[features]` definitions if two writes race. MUST serialize within the cluster. Order: US-002 (establish image-gif package features + forwarding), then US-003 (extend the same feature blocks for voice + source gates). Each story's A/B measurement runs after its commit lands; per-lever wall-time contribution must be isolated.

### Cluster: `docs`
- Stories: US-005
- Phase: 3
- Depends on: `wrapper-seam`, `aws-lc-rs-investigation`, `tui-feature-gates`
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[]; exclusive=[`codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md`, `codex/docs/implementation/build-perf.md`]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Docs depend on the measurement results from all prior clusters. Cannot run until those are landed.

**Parallel handoff:** `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition .ralph/jobs/codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold/suggested-decomposition.json`

## Open Questions

- **Wrapper env-var name:** `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE` (this plan's recommendation; semantically accurate — the env var ENABLES features the harness opts into) vs `CARGO_FEATURES_TO_DISABLE` (the seed prompt's suggestion; semantically misleading — see Research Findings). The impl phase should confirm with the operator if they have a strong preference; otherwise default to `CODEX_FEATURE_OVERRIDE`.
- **Codex + Copilot Phase 4 review** failed in the async path during plan drafting. If the same async-mode stdio loss recurs in Phase 4, fall back to Claude-only review and note in the plan-review section.
- **Lever B stub completeness:** feature-off builds must use the generalized Linux-style stubs. Impl agent should verify `chatwidget/realtime.rs`, `chatwidget/settings_popups.rs`, `app/event_dispatch.rs`, and `chatwidget.rs` compile against the no-op `voice` / `audio_device` surfaces before measuring the pruned build.
- **Cargo arg placement for top-level feature selection:** the wrapper must place `--no-default-features --features ...` so the intended `codex-cli` feature set is selected without accidentally pruning unrelated packages such as the launcher or windows-sandbox package. Impl agent must verify with a `-ParseOnly` dry-run that the resolved cargo invocation does what the harness intends.
- **`utils/image/Cargo.toml` duplicate dep line at `:12` and `:20`** — need to view in impl phase to determine whether both lines need the edit or just one (target-block split possibility).

### Open review findings (soft-cap — Medium-only state at the start of iteration 5)

The Phase 4 plan-review loop fixed all 6 High findings (F-001..F-006) and then hit the
Medium-only soft cap. The following Medium / Low findings remain open and are deferred to the
impl phase as guidance rather than blocking issues. Impl agent should incorporate where the
fix is cheap and document any deferrals in the ship summary.

- **F-007 (Medium — image-gif feature semantics clarity):** The plan should specify ONE exact
  shape for the image-gif feature gate (`image = { workspace = true, features = ["jpeg",
  "png", "webp"] }` always-on + `[features] default = ["image-gif"]; image-gif =
  ["image/gif"]`) and delete any wavering alternatives. Impl phase should pick the shape
  during US-002 implementation, document in the commit message, and not deviate at apply time.
- **F-008 (Medium — A/B framing internal consistency):** Add an explicit note to the
  measurement methodology: both BEFORE and AFTER runs are cold (full sccache + target
  wipe); the wall-time delta is the apples-to-apples ship gate; subsequent cached re-runs
  are only sanity checks for cache population. Impl phase should add this note to
  `docs/implementation/build-perf.md` when writing the results table.
- **F-009 (Medium — Lever C investigation sharpness):** Lever C should explicitly forbid
  `[patch.crates-io]` (blanket rebase risk) and skip dep-site overrides at the
  `rama-tls-rustls` site (we don't own that crate's `Cargo.toml`). Impl phase: if cargo
  tree shows multiple owning edges for `aws-lc-rs`, mark dead and stop.
- **F-010 (Medium — AC evidence specificity):** Use `cargo tree -e features -i <crate>
  --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` as the ground-truth verification for each lever (AC-2
  for image, AC-3 for cpal, AC-6 for default-build presence of both). The commands appear
  in the high-fix amendments for AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-6 already; impl phase should make
  sure each lever's ship evidence captures the cargo-tree output diff (before vs after).
- **F-011 (Medium — SANDBOX PATCH §14/§15 inventory completeness):** Add a "SANDBOX PATCH
  inventory" table to the impl-phase deliverable enumerating every upstream-canonical edit
  with three columns: marker text, §14 invariant statement, enforcing test/guard command.
  Files in scope: `tui/Cargo.toml`, `utils/image/Cargo.toml`, `tui/src/lib.rs`, plus the
  F-001 dep-edge edits (`cli/Cargo.toml`, `core/Cargo.toml`, possibly `protocol/Cargo.toml`),
  plus (Lever C only if applied) workspace `Cargo.toml`.
- **F-012 (Medium — wrapper env-var design narrower):** A closed-allowlist env var
  (`CODEX_PRUNED_FEATURES=voice,image-gif[,aws-lc-rs]`) parsed against a fixed set is more
  robust than a free-form CSV. The high-fix amendments already moved AC-1 toward this
  shape; impl phase should reify the recognized set in `measure-build.ps1` with an explicit
  parse-time error for unknown names.
- **F-013 (Medium — measurement artifact path consistency):** Pick ONE path for the
  measurement CSV evidence. Recommend keeping the existing
  `codex/docs/implementation/build-perf-artifacts/<runId>.csv` (established convention).
  If a second copy under `.ralph/jobs/codex-rs-feature-pruning-for-sub-45m-cold/` is needed
  for the ship record, add an explicit `Copy-Item` step and document the duplication. Impl
  phase: ensure the same path is referenced in build-perf.md and in the ship summary.
- **F-014 (Medium — US-001 standalone validation):** US-001 (wrapper seam) cannot be
  end-to-end validated until at least the F-001 dep-edge edits land (`cli/Cargo.toml` etc.)
  and one lever ships. The high-fix amendments restructured Phase 1 to bundle dep-edge
  plumbing with US-001 — impl agent should confirm this is reflected in the story
  decomposition cluster mapping before kicking off.
- **F-015 (Low — SANDBOX PATCH exact marker text):** The §14 invariant inventory (F-011)
  should include the exact `# SANDBOX PATCH:` / `// SANDBOX PATCH:` comment text for each
  edit (e.g., `# SANDBOX PATCH: cpal optional + voice cargo feature for sub-45m cold-cache
  prune; see patch-surface.md §14 inv-N + §15 replant.`). Impl phase agent should write the
